name: Mia
source:
A diligent apprentice at the Black Rose Revue Music School, Mia harbors dreams of becoming an esteemed otokoyaku. Her passion leads her through the theater's echoing halls, shadowing the footsteps of the actresses she adores, absorbing the whispers of the stage.

[From [url=https://yamino.itch.io/black-rose-revue]itch.io[/url]]
